sentences.zh: 高宗時，戊寅曆益疎，淳風作甲子元曆以獻。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Gaozong, the Wuyin calendar grew ever coarser; Chunfeng composed the Jiazi Origin calendar and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Gaozong the Wuyin calendar grew increasingly inaccurate; Li Chunfeng composed the Jiazi Origin calendar and presented it.

sentences.zh: 詔太史起麟德二年頒用，謂之麟德曆。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Grand Astrologer to promulgate it from Lindé year 2, calling it the Lindé calendar.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Grand Astrologer to implement it from Lindé year 2; it was called the Lindé Calendar.

sentences.zh: 古曆有章、蔀，有元、紀，有日分、度分，參差不齊，淳風為總法千三百四十以一之。

translations.literal: Ancient calendars had rules, obscurations, origins, eras, day parts, and degree parts, all uneven; Chunfeng unified them under one general factor of 1,340.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient calendars used rules, obscurations, origins, eras, day parts, and degree parts in inconsistent units; Chunfeng unified them with a single general factor of 1,340.

sentences.zh: 損益中晷術以考日至，為木渾圖以測黃道，餘因劉焯皇極曆法，增損所宜。

translations.literal: He adjusted the gnomon midday method to verify solstice arrival, made a wooden armillary to measure the ecliptic, and for the rest drew on Liu Chuo's Huangji calendar method with appropriate additions and subtractions.
translations.idiomatic: He revised the gnomon midday method to determine solstice arrival, built a wooden armillary to measure the ecliptic, and otherwise adapted Liu Chuo's Huangji calendar with suitable adjustments.

sentences.zh: 當時以為密，與太史令瞿曇羅所上經緯曆參行。

translations.literal: At the time it was considered precise and was used alongside the Jingwei calendar submitted by Grand Astrologer Qu Tanluo.
translations.idiomatic: It was then regarded as precise and was used concurrently with the Jingwei calendar that Grand Astrologer Qu Tanluo had submitted.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年十二月甲寅朔，壬午晦。

translations.literal: Hongdao year 1, twelfth month: jiayin new moon, renchen last day of month.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongdao year 1 the twelfth month began on jiayin and ended on renchen.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔二年元日用甲申，故進以癸未晦焉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict set year 2's New Year on jiashen; therefore it was advanced to guwei as last day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month an edict fixed New Year's Day of year 2 on jiashen, so the prior month-end was advanced to guwei.

sentences.zh: 永昌元年十一月，改元載初，用周正，以十二月為臘月，建寅月為一月。

translations.literal: Yongchang year 1, eleventh month: the era name changed to Zaichu; Zhou calendar was adopted—twelfth month became La month, and the month beginning with yin became the first month.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongchang year 1, eleventh month, the era became Zaichu; the court adopted the Zhou calendar, making the twelfth month La month and the yin month the first month.

sentences.zh: 神功二年，司曆以臘為閏，而前歲之晦，月見東方，太后詔以正月為閏十月。

translations.literal: Shenggong year 2, calendar officials made La month intercalary, but at the prior year's last day the moon was seen in the east; the Empress Dowager decreed that the first month become intercalary tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenggong year 2 the calendar office intercalated La month, but the moon appeared in the east on the prior year's last day; the Empress Dowager decreed that the first month become intercalary tenth month.

sentences.zh: 是歲，甲子南至，改元聖曆。

translations.literal: That year, jiazi winter solstice occurred; the era name changed to Shenglü.
translations.idiomatic: That year, at jiazi winter solstice, the era name was changed to Shenglü.

sentences.zh: 命瞿曇羅作光宅曆，將用之。

translations.literal: Qu Tanluo was ordered to compose the Guangzhai calendar, intending to use it.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Tanluo was ordered to compose the Guangzhai calendar for imminent use.

sentences.zh: 三年，罷作光宅曆，復行夏時，終開元十六年。

translations.literal: Year 3, work on the Guangzhai calendar was suspended; Xia calendar was resumed until Kaiyuan year 16.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 work on the Guangzhai calendar was halted and the Xia calendar restored, continuing through Kaiyuan year 16.

sentences.zh: 麟德曆麟德元年甲子，距上元積二十六萬九千八百八十算。

translations.literal: Lindé calendar: Lindé year 1 jiazi, accumulated count from high origin: 269,880.
translations.idiomatic: For the Lindé Calendar, Lindé year 1 jiazi stood 269,880 counts from the high origin.

translations.literal: General factor: 1,340.

sentences.zh: 朞實四十八萬九千四百二十八。

translations.literal: Sequence constant: 489,428.

sentences.zh: 常朔實三萬九千五百七十一。

translations.literal: Mean new-moon constant: 39,571.

sentences.zh: 加三百六十二曰盈朔實，減三百五十一曰朒朔實。

translations.literal: Adding 362 yields the waxing new-moon constant; subtracting 351 yields the waning new-moon constant.
translations.idiomatic: Add 362 for the waxing new-moon constant; subtract 351 for the waning new-moon constant.

translations.literal: Double-hour rate: 335.
Multiply accumulated count by sequence constant to get sequence total.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the accumulated count by the sequence constant to obtain the sequence total.

translations.literal: Divide by general factor; each quotient is a day.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the general factor; each quotient is one day.

sentences.zh: 六十去之，命甲子算外，得冬至。

translations.literal: Remove multiples of 60; count from beyond jiazi to get winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Cast out multiples of 60, count from beyond jiazi, and obtain winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 累加日十五、小餘二百九十二、小分六之五，得次氣。

translations.literal: Cumulatively add 15 days, 292 minor remainder, and five-sixths of a minor part to get the next qi.
translations.idiomatic: Add cumulatively 15 days, 292 minor remainder, and 5/6 of a minor part to obtain the next qi.

sentences.zh: 六乘小餘，辰率而一，命子半算外，各其加時。

translations.literal: Six times minor remainder, divide by double-hour rate; count from beyond zi half to get each add-time.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the minor remainder by 6, divide by the double-hour rate, and count from beyond mid-zi for each add-time.

sentences.zh: 以常朔實去朞總，不滿為閏餘。

translations.literal: Remove sequence total by mean new-moon constant; the remainder is intercalation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Cast the mean new-moon constant out of the sequence total; what remains is the intercalation remainder.

sentences.zh: 以閏餘減朞總，為總實，如總法得一，為日。

translations.literal: Subtract intercalation remainder from sequence total to get total proper; divide by general factor for days.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the intercalation remainder from the sequence total for total proper; divide by the general factor for days.

translations.literal: Subtract from winter solstice to get mean astronomical new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract from winter solstice to obtain the mean astronomical new moon.

sentences.zh: 又以常朔小餘并閏餘，以減朞總，為總實。

translations.literal: Also combine mean new-moon minor remainder with intercalation remainder, subtract from sequence total for total proper.
translations.idiomatic: Also add the mean new-moon minor remainder to the intercalation remainder and subtract from the sequence total for total proper.

sentences.zh: 因常朔加日二十九、小餘七百一十一，得次朔。

translations.literal: From mean new moon, add 29 days and 711 minor remainder to get next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: From the mean new moon add 29 days and 711 minor remainder to obtain the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 因朔加日七、小餘五百一十二太，得上弦。

translations.literal: From new moon add 7 days, 512 and 3/4 minor remainder, for first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: From new moon add 7 days and 512 3/4 minor remainder for first quarter.

translations.literal: Add again for full moon and last quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Add again for full moon and last quarter.

sentences.zh: 各以其氣率并後氣率而半之，十二乘之，綱紀除之，為末率。

translations.literal: For each, add its qi rate and the following qi rate, halve them, multiply by 12, divide by cord and era, to get final rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each solar term, add its rate and the next term's rate, halve the sum, multiply by 12, and divide by cord and era to obtain the final rate.

sentences.zh: 二率相減，餘以十二乘之，綱紀除，為總差。

translations.literal: Subtract the two rates; multiply the remainder by 12, divide by cord and era, for total difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two rates, multiply the remainder by 12, and divide by cord and era for the total difference.

sentences.zh: 又以十二乘總差，綱紀除之，為別差。

translations.literal: Again multiply total difference by 12, divide by cord and era, for separate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the total difference by 12 again and divide by cord and era for the separate difference.

sentences.zh: 以總差前少以減末率，前多以加末率，為初率。

translations.literal: If prior is less, subtract total difference from final rate; if prior is more, add to final rate—for initial rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the prior term is deficient, subtract the total difference from the final rate; if excessive, add it—to obtain the initial rate.

sentences.zh: 累以別差，前少以加初率，前多以減初率，為每日躔差及先後率。

translations.literal: Accumulate separate difference: if prior is less add to initial rate, if prior is more subtract from initial rate—for daily lodging difference and advance-retard rate.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the separate difference: add to the initial rate when the prior term is deficient, subtract when excessive—to obtain the daily lodging difference and advance-retard rate.

sentences.zh: 乃循積而損益之，各得其日定氣消息與盈朒積。

translations.literal: Then follow the accumulation with increase and decrease, each obtaining its day's fixed qi discharge-recovery and wax-wane accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Then adjust cumulatively to obtain each day's fixed qi discharge-recovery and wax-wane accumulation.

sentences.zh: 其後無同率，因前末為初率；

translations.literal: When later terms share no identical rate, take the prior final as initial rate;
translations.idiomatic: When later terms have no matching rate, take the prior final rate as the initial rate;

sentences.zh: 前少者加總差，前多者以總差減之，為末率。

translations.literal: if prior is less add total difference, if prior is more subtract total difference from it—for final rate.
translations.idiomatic: if the prior term is deficient add the total difference; if excessive subtract the total difference—for the final rate.

translations.literal: The rest follows the method.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the remaining steps according to the method.

sentences.zh: 各以氣下消息積，息減、消加常氣，為定氣。

translations.literal: For each, use the discharge-recovery accumulation below the qi: subtract discharge, add reduction to mean qi, for fixed qi.
translations.idiomatic: For each solar term, apply the discharge-recovery accumulation below it: subtract discharge and add reduction from the mean qi to obtain fixed qi.

sentences.zh: 各以定氣大小餘減所近朔望大小餘，十二通其日，以辰率約其餘，相從為辰總。

translations.literal: For each, subtract nearest new-moon or full-moon large and minor remainders from fixed qi large and minor remainders; multiply days by 12, reduce remainder by double-hour rate, combine for double-hour total.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the nearest new-moon or full-moon large and minor remainders from each fixed qi's remainders; multiply days by 12, reduce the remainder by the double-hour rate, and combine for the double-hour total.

sentences.zh: 其氣前多以乘末率，前少以乘初率，十二而一，為總率。

translations.literal: If qi is prior-more multiply final rate; if prior-less multiply initial rate; divide by 12—for total rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the qi is prior-excessive multiply by the final rate; if prior-deficient multiply by the initial rate; divide by 12 for the total rate.

sentences.zh: 前多者，以辰總減綱紀，以乘十二，綱紀而一，以加總率，辰總乘之，二十四除之；

translations.literal: If prior-more: subtract double-hour total from cord and era, multiply by 12, divide by cord and era, add to total rate; multiply by double-hour total, divide by 24;
translations.idiomatic: If prior-excessive: subtract the double-hour total from cord and era, multiply by 12, divide by cord and era, and add to the total rate; multiply by the double-hour total and divide by 24;

sentences.zh: 前少者，辰總再乘別差，二百八十八除之：皆加總率。

translations.literal: if prior-less: double-hour total twice multiplied by separate difference, divide by 288: both add to total rate.
translations.idiomatic: if prior-deficient: multiply the double-hour total twice by the separate difference and divide by 288—in both cases add to the total rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以先加、後減其氣盈朒積為定。

translations.literal: Then advance-add and retard-subtract the qi wax-wane accumulation for the fixed value.
translations.idiomatic: Then advance-add and retard-subtract the qi wax-wane accumulation to obtain the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 以定積盈加、朒減常朔弦望，得盈朒大小餘。

translations.literal: With fixed accumulation wax-add and wane-subtract mean new-moon and quarter-moon phases, for wax-wane large and minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the fixed accumulation to wax-add and wane-subtract the mean new, first-quarter, full, and last-quarter moons, obtaining wax-wane large and minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 變周四十四萬三千七十七。

translations.literal: Change cycle: 443,077.

sentences.zh: 變日二十七，餘七百四十三，變奇一。

translations.literal: Change days 27, remainder 743, change odd 1.
Change-odd factor: 12.
Lunar circuit factor: 67.

sentences.zh: 以奇法乘總實，滿變周，去之；

translations.literal: Multiply total proper by odd factor; cast out full change cycles;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply total proper by the odd factor; cast out full change cycles;

sentences.zh: 不滿者，奇法而一，為變分。

translations.literal: what does not fill, divide by odd factor, for change parts.
translations.idiomatic: what remains, divide by the odd factor, for change parts.

sentences.zh: 盈總法從日，得天正常朔夜半入變。

translations.literal: Excess general factor carries into days, obtaining mean astronomical new-moon midnight entry into change.
translations.idiomatic: Carry excess general factor into days to obtain mean astronomical new moon at midnight entry into change.

sentences.zh: 加常朔小餘，為經辰所入。

translations.literal: Add mean new-moon minor remainder, for circuit double-hour entry.
translations.idiomatic: Add the mean new-moon minor remainder for the circuit double-hour entry.

sentences.zh: 因朔加七日、餘五百一十二、奇九，得上弦。

translations.literal: From new moon add 7 days, remainder 512, odd 9, for first quarter.
translations.idiomatic: From new moon add 7 days, remainder 512, and odd 9 for first quarter.

translations.literal: Continue adding for full moon, last quarter, and next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Continue adding for full moon, last quarter, and the next new moon.

translations.literal: When addition fills change days and remainder, cast out.
translations.idiomatic: When the sum fills change days and remainder, cast it out.

sentences.zh: 又以所入盈朒定積，盈加、朒減之，得朔、弦、望盈朒經辰所入。

translations.literal: Again with wax-wane fixed accumulation at entry, wax-add and wane-subtract, for new-moon and quarter-moon wax-wane circuit double-hour entry.
translations.idiomatic: Again apply the wax-wane fixed accumulation at entry—wax-add and wane-subtract—to obtain wax-wane circuit double-hour entry for new moon and quarters.

sentences.zh: 減百四十四初減七十一末增入後

translations.literal: decrease 144; at beginning decrease 71, at end increase into the next
translations.idiomatic: decrease rate 144; −71 at day-start, carry increase into next day

sentences.zh: 以離程與次相減，得進退差；

translations.literal: Subtract the next separation progression from the separation progression to get the advance-retreat difference;
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the next day's separation progression from the current one to obtain the advance-retreat difference.

sentences.zh: 後多為進，後少為退，等為平。

translations.literal: If the latter is greater it is advance; if lesser it is retreat; if equal it is level.
translations.idiomatic: If the next value is larger, the motion is advancing; if smaller, retreating; if equal, level.

sentences.zh: 各列朔、弦、望盈朒經辰所入日增減率，并後率而半之，為通率。

translations.literal: For each new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter excess-deficit canonical-time entry day, list the increase-decrease rate; combine with the next rate and halve to get the common rate.
translations.idiomatic: For each syzygy and quarter-moon excess-deficit canonical-time entry, list the day's increase-decrease rate, average it with the next day's rate, and take the result as the common rate.

translations.literal: Also subtract the two rates to get the rate difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the two rates to obtain the rate difference.

sentences.zh: 增者以入變曆日餘減總法，餘乘率差，總法而一，并率差而半之；

translations.literal: For increasing cases: subtract the variable-calendar day remainder from the total divisor; multiply the remainder by the rate difference, divide by the total divisor, combine with the rate difference and halve;
translations.idiomatic: For increasing rates: subtract the variable-calendar day remainder from the total divisor, multiply the remainder by the rate difference and divide by the total divisor, then add half the rate difference;

sentences.zh: 減者半入餘乘率差，亦總法而一：皆加通率。

translations.literal: For decreasing cases: halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference, also divide by the total divisor: in all cases add the common rate.
translations.idiomatic: For decreasing rates: halve the entry remainder, multiply by the rate difference and divide by the total divisor; in both cases add the common rate.

sentences.zh: 以乘入餘，總法除，為經辰變率。

translations.literal: Multiply by the entry remainder, divide by the total divisor, to get the canonical-time variable rate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the entry remainder and divide by the total divisor to obtain the canonical-time variable rate.

sentences.zh: 半之，以速減、遲加入餘，為轉餘。

translations.literal: Halve it; subtract fast, add slow to the entry remainder, to get the transfer remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Halve it, subtract the fast component and add the slow component to the entry remainder, yielding the transfer remainder.

sentences.zh: 增者以減總法，減者因餘：皆乘率差，總法而一；

translations.literal: For increasing cases subtract from the total divisor; for decreasing cases use the remainder as basis: in all cases multiply by the rate difference, divide by the total divisor;
translations.idiomatic: For increasing cases subtract from the total divisor; for decreasing cases use the remainder directly; multiply by the rate difference and divide by the total divisor;

sentences.zh: 以加通率，變率乘之，總法除之，以速減、遲加變率，為定率。

translations.literal: Add to the common rate; multiply the variable rate by it, divide by the total divisor; subtract fast, add slow to the variable rate, to get the fixed rate.
translations.idiomatic: Add to the common rate, multiply the variable rate thereby and divide by the total divisor; subtract fast and add slow to the variable rate to fix the rate.

sentences.zh: 乃以定率增減遲速積為定。

translations.literal: Then use the fixed rate to increase or decrease the slow-fast accumulation to get the fixed value.
translations.idiomatic: Then apply the fixed rate to increase or decrease the slow-fast accumulation and obtain the fixed value.

translations.literal: Where there is no matching rate afterward, also derive from the prior rate.
translations.idiomatic: Where no matching rate follows, derive from the preceding rate likewise.

sentences.zh: 應增者，以通率為初數，半率差而減之；

translations.literal: For cases that should increase, take the common rate as the initial number and subtract half the rate difference;
translations.idiomatic: When increase applies, take the common rate as the initial value and subtract half the rate difference;

translations.literal: For cases that should decrease, it is simply the common rate.
translations.idiomatic: When decrease applies, the common rate itself is used.

sentences.zh: 其曆率損益入餘進退日者，分為二日，隨餘初末，如法求之，所得并以加減變率為定。

translations.literal: Where the calendar rate's increase-decrease shifts the entry remainder across day boundaries, split into two days; according to whether the remainder is at beginning or end, seek by the method; combine the results and add-subtract to the variable rate to fix it.
translations.idiomatic: When a calendar rate's increase-decrease pushes the entry remainder across a day boundary, split the day in two; compute separately for the beginning and end portions, then combine and adjust the variable rate accordingly.

translations.literal: Adding to the normal day is excess; subtracting from the normal day is deficit.

sentences.zh: 各為定大小餘，命日如前。

translations.literal: For each fix the major and minor remainders, name the day as before.
translations.idiomatic: Fix the major and minor remainders for each and name the day as before.

sentences.zh: 乃前朔、後朔迭相推校，盈朒之課，據實為準；

translations.literal: Then the prior new moon and next new moon are checked against each other iteratively; the excess-deficit assessment takes actual results as standard;
translations.idiomatic: Then cross-check successive new moons iteratively, taking actual excess-deficit results as the standard;

translations.literal: Decreases must not encroach on deficit; increases must not exceed excess.
translations.idiomatic: Decreases must not violate deficit limits; increases must not exceed excess limits.

sentences.zh: 定朔日名與次朔同者大，不同者小，無中氣者為閏月。

translations.literal: Fixed new moon: if the day name matches the next new moon it is the major month; if different, the minor month; without a mid-qi it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: For the fixed new moon: same day-name as the next new moon means a major (30-day) month; different means a minor (29-day) month; no mid-term qi marks an intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 其元日有交、加時應見者，消息前後一兩月，以定大小，令虧在晦、二，弦、望亦隨消息。

translations.literal: If on the origin day there is a crossing and the hour of occurrence should be visible, shift by one or two months before or after per the decrease-increase cycle, to fix major/minor month, so that deficiency falls on the last day or second day; first quarter and full moon also follow the decrease-increase cycle.
translations.idiomatic: When a crossing on the origin day should be visible at the computed hour, shift one or two months per the emission-absorption cycle to fix month length, placing deficiency on the last or second day; quarter and full moons follow the same cycle.

sentences.zh: 月朔盈朒之極，不過頻三。

translations.literal: The extreme of new-moon excess-deficit occurs at most three times in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Consecutive new-moon excess or deficit occurs at most three times in a row.

translations.idiomatic: Accumulate by adding one day to obtain the next day.

translations.idiomatic: Where extended subtract and where contracted add to the ecliptic departure from the pole at the start of the qi, to obtain each day's value.

translations.literal: From new moon seek full moon, add the true full moon [parts].
translations.idiomatic: From new moon to find full moon, add the true full moon parts.

translations.idiomatic: For each, take the new-moon or full-moon entry-qi elongation fixed accumulation; add if elongating, subtract if contracting;

translations.idiomatic: also multiply the slow-fast fixed number by 60 and divide by 777 to obtain the limit number;

translations.literal: slow subtract, fast add, as the fixed node parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract if slow and add if fast to obtain the fixed node parts.

sentences.zh: 其朔，月在日道裏者，以所入限數減遲速定數，餘以速減、遲加其定交分。

translations.literal: At new moon, if the moon is inside the solar path, subtract the limit number entered from the slow-fast fixed number; the remainder—slow subtract, fast add to its fixed node parts.
translations.idiomatic: At new moon, if the moon is inside the solar path, subtract the limit number entered from the slow-fast fixed number; with the remainder, subtract if slow and add if fast to the fixed node parts.

sentences.zh: 而出日道表者，為變交分。

translations.literal: If it exits outside the solar path, that is the variable node parts.
translations.idiomatic: If it exits outside the solar path, that is the variable node parts.

translations.literal: If it does not exit outside, follow the fixed node parts.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not exit outside, use the fixed node parts.

sentences.zh: 其變交分三時半內者，依術消息，以定蝕不。

translations.literal: If the variable node parts are within three and a half double-hours, follow the waxing-waning procedure to fix whether there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the variable node parts fall within 3.5 double-hours, apply the waxing-waning procedure to determine whether an eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 交中已下者，為月在外道；

translations.literal: Below the mid-node, the moon is on the outer path;
translations.idiomatic: Below the mid-node, the moon is on the outer path;

sentences.zh: 已上者，去之，餘為月在內道。

translations.literal: above it, remove it; the remainder is the moon on the inner path.
translations.idiomatic: above it, subtract; the remainder is the moon on the inner path.

sentences.zh: 其分如後準已下，為交後分；

translations.literal: If the parts are at or below the posterior limit, that is post-node parts;
translations.idiomatic: If the parts are at or below the posterior limit, that is post-node parts;

sentences.zh: 前準已上者，反減交中，餘為交前分。

translations.literal: if at or above the prior limit, inversely subtract from the node center; the remainder is pre-node parts.
translations.idiomatic: if at or above the prior limit, subtract inversely from the node center; the remainder is pre-node parts.

sentences.zh: 望則月蝕，朔在內道則日蝕。

translations.literal: At full moon there is a lunar eclipse; at new moon, if on the inner path there is a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon there is a lunar eclipse; at new moon, if on the inner path, there is a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 百一十二約前後分，為去交時。

translations.literal: Reduce pre- and post-node parts by 112, as distance-from-node in double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: Divide pre- and post-node parts by 112 to obtain the distance-from-node in double-hours.

translations.literal: Set the fixed new-moon minor remainder and set it aside.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed new-moon minor remainder aside.

sentences.zh: 辰率約之，以艮、巽、坤、乾為次，命算外。

translations.literal: Reduce by the double-hour rate; in sequence gen, xun, kun, qian, count beyond the tally.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the double-hour rate; in sequence gen, xun, kun, qian, count beyond the tally.

translations.literal: Of the remainder, at or below half the divisor is initial;
translations.idiomatic: Of the remainder, at or below half the divisor is initial;

translations.literal: above that, remove it, as final.
translations.idiomatic: above that, subtract to obtain final.

sentences.zh: 初則因餘，末則減法，各為差率。

translations.literal: If initial, then follow the remainder; if final, subtract the divisor—each is the difference-rate.
translations.idiomatic: If initial, use the remainder; if final, subtract the divisor—each gives the difference-rate.

sentences.zh: 月在內道者，益去交時十而三除之。

translations.literal: If the moon is on the inner path, increase the distance-from-node in double-hours by three-tenths and divide.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is on the inner path, increase the distance-from-node in double-hours by three-tenths and divide.

sentences.zh: 以乘差率，十四而一，為差。

translations.literal: Multiply by the difference-rate; one-fourteenth, as the difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the difference-rate and divide by 14 to obtain the difference.

sentences.zh: 其朔，在二分前後一氣內，即以差為定；

translations.literal: At new moon, if within one qi before or after either equinox, use the difference as fixed;
translations.idiomatic: At new moon, if within one qi before or after either equinox, use the difference as fixed;

sentences.zh: 近冬至以去寒露、雨水，近夏至以去清明、白露氣數倍之，又三除去交時增之；

translations.literal: near winter solstice use the distance from Cold Dew and Rain Water; near summer solstice use the distance from Clear and Bright and White Dew; multiply the qi count and again three-tenths remove the distance-from-node increase;

translations.literal: Seeking motion-parts, all use half-total to multiply fixed degree-rate, if there are parts follow them.
translations.idiomatic: To find motion-parts, multiply the fixed degree-rate by the half-total, carrying any fractional parts.

translations.literal: Day-rate divide, as uniform-motion degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the day-rate to get the uniform-motion degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 置定日率，減一，以所差分乘之，二而一，為差率。

translations.literal: Set fixed day-rate, subtract one, use differential parts to multiply it, divide by two, as differential rate.
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed day-rate, subtract 1, multiply by the differential parts, and halve the result to get the differential rate.

sentences.zh: 以疾減、遲加平行，為初日所行度及分。

translations.literal: Use fast diminish slow add to uniform motion, as initial day traveled degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for acceleration and add for deceleration to the uniform motion to get the initial day's degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 中宗反正，太史丞南宮說以麟德曆上元，五星有入氣加減，非合璧連珠之正，以神龍元年歲次乙巳，故治乙巳元曆。

translations.literal: When Zhongzong restored the throne, Chief Clerk of the Astrological Office Nangong Shuo, because the Lindé calendar origin had the five planets with entering-qi add-subtract, not the correct alignment of combined disks and strung pearls, using Shenlong year 1 year-count yi-si, therefore compiled the Yisi Origin Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongzong restored the throne, Chief Clerk of the Astrological Office Nangong Shuo held that the Lindé calendar's origin epoch, with its five-planet qi-entry adjustments, did not match the true alignment of combined disks and strung pearls; using Shenlong 1, year yi-si, he therefore compiled the Yisi Origin Calendar.

sentences.zh: 推而上之，積四十一萬四千三百六十算，得十一月甲子朔夜半冬至，七曜起牽牛之初。

translations.literal: Extrapolating upward, accumulated four hundred fourteen thousand three hundred sixty counts, obtaining eleventh month jiazi new moon midnight winter solstice, seven luminaries beginning at the start of Ox.
translations.idiomatic: Extrapolating upward, with an accumulated count of 414,360, he obtained eleventh-month jiazi new moon at midnight on winter solstice, with the seven luminaries beginning at the start of Ox.

sentences.zh: 其術有黃道而無赤道，推五星先步定合，加伏日以求定見。

translations.literal: Its method has the ecliptic but not the equator; computing the five planets first steps out fixed conjunction, adds invisibility days to seek fixed appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Its method used the ecliptic but not the equator; computing the five planets began with stepping out the fixed conjunction and adding invisibility days to obtain fixed appearance.

translations.literal: The rest is the same as Chunfeng's method.
translations.idiomatic: The rest was the same as Li Chunfeng's method.

translations.literal: What differs is only the mean-conjunction add-subtract difference.
translations.idiomatic: What differed was only the add-subtract difference at mean conjunction.

translations.literal: Once completed, Ruizong took the throne and abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: Once it was completed, Ruizong took the throne and it was abolished.
